confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Montevideo prices and regional comparables; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is most uncertain and varies with season and neighbourhood. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the local beer relationship (cocktail roughly 2x beer, wine glass roughly 1.5x beer), since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. July is Uruguayan winter, so accommodation is taken at shoulder-season levels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Uruguay generally prices above most South American peers. Anchors are benchmarked against mid-sized Latin American capitals with a tourist hotel market and a similar restaurant price level, adjusted for Uruguay's higher cost of dining and hotels.
